description: The scan response data layer: a tagged/weighted arm-only allowlist + per-gesture channel sets + seedable weighted picker + scan detection rules in detection_routine_map.py, plus making brains/hypnotic buildable arm-only (neck MovementSpec dropped; hypnotic gate removed) via a scan flag in animatronic.py, and a one-line beckon docstring fix in movements.py. This is the data/definition layer the FEAT-003 loop consumes. Independent of FEAT-001; both must land before FEAT-003.
steps: In src/detection_routine_map.py (keep it logic-only: stdlib + vision_models + random; NO servo/camera/subprocess, NO scan-specific logging) add: ARM_ONLY_CHANNELS = frozenset({3,4,5,6,7}) with a comment that it is the complement of the neck tracker's {NECK_PAN=0, NECK_TILT=1} and includes RT_WRIST_TILT=3 (so the bound is NOT {4,5,6,7}).

Add SCAN_GESTURE_CHANNELS = {'beckon': frozenset({3,4,5,6,7}), 'comeHere': frozenset({3,4,5,6,7}), 'wave': frozenset({3,4,5,6,7})} with a comment that gestures carry no owned_channels field so these are declared here as the subset guardrail (verified against movements.py: beckon/come_here curl the wrist to 170; _wave_arm writes RT_WRIST_TILT).
Add 'from enum import Enum' and class ScanActionKind(Enum): GESTURE='gesture'; ROUTINE='routine'. Add GESTURE_WEIGHT=5, ROUTINE_WEIGHT=1.

Add SCAN_SAFE_ARM_ACTIONS = {'beckon': GESTURE, 'comeHere': GESTURE, 'wave': GESTURE, 'brains': ROUTINE, 'hypnotic': ROUTINE} and a COMMENTED-OUT, FLAGGED '# "burp": ScanActionKind.ROUTINE,' entry whose comment explains burp is head-coupled: its coverMouth hand-to-mouth pose is operator-verified safe only with the head centered (NECK_PAN=90, NECK_TILT=90), scan holds the head off-center, FORBIDDEN_COMBINATIONS has no neck term, so DO NOT enable until an operator bench-verifies the fold clears the head across the full tracking envelope. Cite coverMouth (not yawnCover).

Add pure helpers in the same module: weighted_scan_pool(allow=SCAN_SAFE_ARM_ACTIONS) returning a list of names with each GESTURE repeated GESTURE_WEIGHT times and each ROUTINE ROUTINE_WEIGHT times; choose_scan_action(allow=SCAN_SAFE_ARM_ACTIONS) returning random.choice(weighted_scan_pool(allow)) using the shared stdlib random module (so random.seed(x) is reproducible).

Add SCAN_RESPONSE_COOLDOWN_S = 8.0 and scan_rules() -> [DetectionRule(required_classes=(PERSON_LABEL,), action='scan', cooldown_s=SCAN_RESPONSE_COOLDOWN_S), DetectionRule(required_classes=(PERSON_LABEL, DEFAULT_DOG_LABEL), action='scan', cooldown_s=SCAN_RESPONSE_COOLDOWN_S)]. action='scan' is a dispatch-ignored placeholder; the responder (FEAT-003) always dispatches choose_scan_action() and distinguishes the dog rule by DEFAULT_DOG_LABEL in rule.required_classes.

In src/animatronic.py factor brains() and hypnotic() so the PerformanceDefinition comes from a private builder taking scan: bool (e.g. _brains_performance(self, scan=False), _hypnotic_performance(self, scan=False)). The public methods call the builder with scan=False and run it via asyncio.run(PerformanceRunner(defn, mv, audio_dir[...]).run()) exactly as today (zero behaviour change for the standalone routines).
In _brains_performance(scan=True): build the ConcurrentGroup with ONLY the menacing_reach MovementSpec (owned_channels {4,5,6,7}); omit look_around_random. Audio stays gate=None.

In _hypnotic_performance(scan=True): build the ConcurrentGroup with ONLY hypnotic_arm (owned_channels {4,5,6,7}); omit hyp_head_sway; AND set gate=None so no GateSpec references the dropped movement and no remaining spec has supplies_gate=True (hypnotic_arm is already supplies_gate=False). Keep followup_audio_files, stop_loop_lead_seconds=1.5, player_options jaw/eyes off, and the eye-blink ambient unchanged. (The t=0 audio start is an intended, operator-visible change for the scan variant only.)

In src/movements.py fix the Movements.beckon docstring (near line 1826) so its owned-channel note includes RT_WRIST_TILT (ch 3): authoritative owned set {3,4,5,6,7}. No code change to beckon/come_here/wave/_wave_arm (wave already has include_neck).

Add tests/test_scan_selection.py (SERVO_SIM import convention; imports pure logic only): weighted_scan_pool length 17 (3x5 + 2x1) with 5:1 ratio; choose_scan_action reproducible under random.seed and ~5:1 Gesture:Routine over many draws; burp absent from the shipped pool; every SCAN_GESTURE_CHANNELS[name] <= ARM_ONLY_CHANNELS and ARM_ONLY_CHANNELS == {3,4,5,6,7}; scan_rules() person+dog beats person via DetectionRoutineMap arbitration, each rule keeps its own id()-keyed cooldown, and DEFAULT_DOG_LABEL in the dog rule's required_classes.

Add tests/test_scan_performance.py (SERVO_SIM convention): construct _brains_performance(scan=True) and _hypnotic_performance(scan=True); assert the union of owned_channels across groups is exactly {4,5,6,7} (no 0/1), construction raises NO ChannelOwnershipError, hypnotic scan=True has gate is None and no supplies_gate=True spec, scan=False builds still own {0,1,4,5,6,7}, and a deliberately mis-tagged group containing a neck channel alongside the arm spec DOES raise ChannelOwnershipError.
acceptance_criteria: weighted_scan_pool yields 17 slots with a 5:1 Gesture:Routine ratio and choose_scan_action is seed-reproducible; burp is excluded; verified by passing tests/test_scan_selection.py.
scan_rules() arbitration (person+dog beats person) and per-rule cooldown pass against DetectionRoutineMap.

_brains_performance(scan=True) and _hypnotic_performance(scan=True) own exactly {4,5,6,7}, construct with no ChannelOwnershipError, hypnotic scan=True has gate=None/no gate supplier, and a mis-tagged neck channel still raises ChannelOwnershipError; verified by passing tests/test_scan_performance.py.
findings: DATA LAYER in src/detection_routine_map.py (logic-only; new imports: `random`, `from enum import Enum`, `Dict`). Symbols for FEAT-003 to import `from detection_routine_map import ...`: ARM_ONLY_CHANNELS = frozenset({3,4,5,6,7}) (neck complement, INCLUDES wrist ch3); SCAN_GESTURE_CHANNELS: Dict[str,frozenset] = {'beckon','comeHere','wave' -> frozenset({3,4,5,6,7})}; class ScanActionKind(Enum){GESTURE='gesture',ROUTINE='routine'}; GESTURE_WEIGHT=5, ROUTINE_WEIGHT=1; SCAN_SAFE_ARM_ACTIONS: Dict[str,ScanActionKind] = {'beckon':GESTURE,'comeHere':GESTURE,'wave':GESTURE,'brains':ROUTINE,'hypnotic':ROUTINE} (burp is a commented-out FLAGGED entry — head-coupled coverMouth, DO NOT enable without operator bench-verify); SCAN_RESPONSE_COOLDOWN_S=8.0. Helpers: weighted_scan_pool(allow=SCAN_SAFE_ARM_ACTIONS)->List[str] (17 slots, 3 gestures x5 + 2 routines x1); choose_scan_action(allow=SCAN_SAFE_ARM_ACTIONS)->str (random.choice over the pool, uses shared stdlib random so random.seed is reproducible); scan_rules()->List[DetectionRule] (two rules, both action='scan' placeholder, cooldown_s=SCAN_RESPONSE_COOLDOWN_S -> clamped to int 8 by DetectionRule.__post_init__): rule[0] required_classes=(PERSON_LABEL,), rule[1] required_classes=(PERSON_LABEL, DEFAULT_DOG_LABEL). FEAT-003 responder: always dispatch choose_scan_action(); distinguish the dog case by testing `DEFAULT_DOG_LABEL in rule.required_classes` on the DetectionRule returned by DetectionRoutineMap(scan_rules()).select_action(dets, now). DEFAULT_DOG_LABEL='dog' is already exported by detection_routine_map. PERFORMANCE BUILDERS in src/animatronic.py (Animatronic methods, take the shared Movements instance): defn = self._brains_performance(mv, scan=False) and defn = self._hypnotic_performance(mv, scan=False) build the UNCHANGED standalone definitions (public brains()/hypnotic() now call these). For an arm-only scan response call them with scan=True: _brains_performance(mv, scan=True) drops the look_around_random neck spec -> owned {4,5,6,7}, gate stays None; _hypnotic_performance(mv, scan=True) drops the hyp_head_sway neck spec AND sets gate=None (so no spec supplies_gate; hypnotic_arm is already supplies_gate=False), keeps followup_audio_files, stop_loop_lead_seconds=1.5, player_options {drive_jaw:False, drive_eyes:False}; audio starts at t=0 for the scan variant (intended). FEAT-003 should run the arm-only variant via asyncio.run(PerformanceRunner(defn, mv, audio_dir, rest_channels=frozenset({3,4,5,6,7})).run()) using FEAT-001's rest_channels param so cleanup never rests neck 0/1; hypnotic scan still needs ambient=lambda pb: self._blink_eyes(pb,0.25,0.25). beckon docstring in movements.py now states authoritative owned set {3,4,5,6,7}. Tests added: tests/test_scan_selection.py, tests/test_scan_performance.py (both SERVO_SIM convention, logic-only, no collision sim). Verification: py_compile of the 3 files exits 0; the two test modules pass 16/16.
